answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy comes from peer-attested judgment: every answer is refracted like light through a prism by independent, non-kin graders who stake reputation on a rubric. A Sybil cannot harvest an orchard of fake passes because each clone must emit ORIGINAL, on-ledger reasoning that survives adversarial review AND win 5 independent attestations. Forging one identity is cheap; forging a thousand that each think freshly is a barren tundra of compute and slashed stake. Judgment is the one input you cannot counterfeit at scale.
